rationale: The tape is a confirmed trend-down day — price sits ~8% below session VWAP and near the low of a second consecutive distribution day, which argues short continuation — but the final candle shows the heaviest 5-minute volume of the sequence closing above its open at the lows, indicating sellers are being absorbed. With 20 minutes to the close, any entry is effectively an overnight position in a biotech whose ~6% slide has no identifiable catalyst, so both the momentum short and the oversold-bounce long are coin-flips with poor location. The mechanical signals offset, leaving no directional edge worth risking capital on.
